faq.title: Questions about Meta Ads
faq.text: Can’t see yours? [Drop me a line](#contatti) and I’ll reply by the next business day.

items.question: Meta Ads or Google Ads: which is better?
items.answer: They do different jobs: Google Ads reaches people already searching for you, Meta Ads puts you in front of people who don’t know you yet. For many businesses, the two together beat either one alone.

items.question: How much budget do I need?
items.answer: You can start small, especially with a local audience. The free review gives you a realistic estimate based on your area and goal.

items.question: Do I need professional photos and videos?
items.answer: They help, but they’re not always necessary: authentic content shot on a phone often performs better. I’ll tell you what to prepare and how.

items.question: What are the Pixel and Conversions API?
items.answer: They’re the tools that tell Meta which ads bring in enquiries and sales. Set up properly, they make campaigns more efficient and tracking more reliable, while respecting cookie consent.

items.question: Do I have to post every day?
items.answer: No. Ads and organic posts are two different things: campaigns work even if your page isn’t updated often. A well-kept page does help build trust, though.

items.question: Do I own the ad account?
items.answer: Yes. The account, the page and the data stay yours; I work with partner access. You pay Meta directly, with no markup.
